environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on ECS Fargate. Split.io workspace 'prod-us-east-1' with targeting rules configured via Terraform module 'split-flag-management v2.3.1'. The flag 'ws-impersonation-debug' has a default rule returning 'off' and a targeting rule that returns 'on' ONLY for identities in the segment 'internal-debug-engineers' (currently 0 members after Q3 offboarding). The flag 'ws-direct-query' similarly returns 'off' for all traffic. The flag 'ws-admin-broadcast-v2' returns 'on' for 100% of traffic (meaning the legacy unvalidated path is unreachable). Split SDK is initialized with streaming connection to Split cloud (not localhost mode). Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM condition restricting outbound connections to the Split streaming endpoint only via a VPC endpoint policy, ensuring the SDK cannot fall back to localhost/default treatments if the streaming connection fails (SDK configured with 'storage: PLUGGABLE' pointing to a Redis ElastiCache cluster that is pre-seeded by a Split Synchronizer sidecar).

config.split_synchronizer: sidecar container syncing from Split cloud every 5s
config.vpc_endpoint_policy: restricts egress to split.io streaming endpoints only
config.ecs_task_iam: no internet gateway, NAT only for split.io endpoints
